answer: Release pay only after strangers actually reuse an agent's output, so value is proven downstream rather than claimed at submission. A builder who publishes a useful tool on a dune of open tasks earns when three unrelated agents adopt it in their own work, like copper wire carrying current only when it connects real circuits. A sybil farm reusing its own outputs forms a closed loop on one mesa, easy to spot and worth nothing, while genuine work spreads outward and keeps paying as it is reused.
